protocol_basis.criterion_inheritance: The precedence chain is RoadmapItem.verification_criteria, then per-item decision-letter Acceptance criteria when present, then the driving finding's severity/typed evidence anchor/raising reviewers, then frozen Round-1 cards and venue. Each lower layer may only operationalize the layer above and may not extend it.
protocol_basis.new_standard_rule: Any Phase-1 acceptance requirement that cannot be traced to the inherited yardstick must be separated into new_standards. It is advisory by default and cannot affect the item verdict or decision absent the protocol's later, human-gated escalation path.
protocol_basis.phase1_lint_rule: Each gate is schema- and lint-validated before the next gate. An unregistered material extension or weakening in the committed operationalization is a Phase-1 semantic lint failure even when all structural schemas pass.
protocol_basis.retry_rule: The protocol permits exactly one Phase-1 retry because Phase 1 has not seen the manuscript. A second Phase-1 lint failure produces [RE-REVIEW-ABORT: phase1_lint_failed].
protocol_basis.no_retry_rule: After revised-manuscript exposure, Phase 2A and Phase 2B/2B-prime lint failures abort without retry. This confirmation itself did not repair, regenerate, or retry the audited artifact.
protocol_basis.downstream_invariance: A later verdict that happens not to change does not cure criterion drift: gate validity is assessed before Phase 2A, and the extra or weakened standard is forbidden independently of downstream effect.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: The manuscript names the closest comparator frameworks, states the shared producer-checker features and the P33-specific owner semantics, and bounds every originality statement to documented support.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript provides a focused comparison that names the closest comparator frameworks, identifies the producer-checker features shared with them, distinguishes P33's mathematical owner semantics, and limits every originality or priority statement to the documentary support supplied by that comparison.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies a genuine closest-work comparison or narrows some originality language, but one or more required elements remain absent or incomplete: named closest frameworks, shared producer-checker features, P33-specific owner semantics, or documentary bounds on every originality statement.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if the manuscript broadens or strengthens originality or priority claims beyond documented support, removes or obscures an existing limitation on those claims, or makes the closest-work comparison less specific or less traceable.

material_extension.detail: The fully-addressed test and regression discriminator add priority claims to the pass/fail scope although the exact criterion binds only originality statements. The fully-addressed test also requires support to be supplied by the closest-work comparison, whereas the criterion permits documented support without fixing that exclusive carrier.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: Every artifact named in the reproducibility claim has a resolvable locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, and access condition, or is explicitly identified as unavailable without implying retrievability.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: For every artifact named in the reproducibility claim, the manuscript supplies a resolvable locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, and access condition; any unavailable artifact is explicitly marked unavailable and is not described as retrievable.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript provides genuine retrieval information for some named artifacts, but at least one named artifact lacks a resolvable locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, or access condition, or an unavailable artifact is not clearly distinguished from a retrievable one.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if the manuscript removes or weakens existing artifact identifiers or availability qualifications, introduces additional named artifacts without the required retrieval fields, or more strongly implies retrievability for an unresolved or unavailable artifact.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: Complete standalone correction bibliography entries for P33-S03 and P33-S16 are resolvable from references.bib; every affected use is bound to both its base record and the applicable correction record; the existing claim boundaries are preserved; and the references.bib mutation is covered by separate bibliography authorization, because B0044 and B0107 alone do not authorize it.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The references surface contains complete, independently resolvable standalone correction entries for P33-S03 and P33-S16; every affected manuscript use binds both the base record and applicable correction record; existing claim boundaries remain explicit; and the references.bib mutation has separate bibliography authorization rather than relying on B0044 or B0107.

material_weakening.detail: The exact criterion requires the entries to be resolvable from references.bib. The operationalization changes that carrier to the broader and undefined 'references surface', so entries located elsewhere could satisfy its first clause while failing the inherited criterion.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: The main methods text states the field-facing evidence-synthesis procedure without role-by-role process narration, and any retained phase history is clearly separated as provenance.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The main methods text explains the field-facing evidence-synthesis procedure through corpus scope, source-effect synthesis, architectural inference, and evidentiary limits without role-by-role narration, while any retained numbered-phase history appears only in a clearly provenance-labeled, separate surface.

material_extension.detail: It makes a four-part decomposition—corpus scope, source-effect synthesis, architectural inference, and evidentiary limits—a mandatory evidence pattern. Those components occur in the roadmap's suggested action, not in the exact verification criterion, and are not a formally inherited acceptance requirement.

material_weakening.detail: The exact criterion requires any retained phase history to be separated as provenance. The operationalization narrows this to retained numbered-phase history, leaving unnumbered phase-history narration outside its test.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: A frozen fixture set contains independently authored expected outcomes and recorded oracle provenance; a trust graph enumerates producers, adapters, checker kernels, libraries, theorem encodings, fixture-oracle authorship, and accountable implementers; every shared dependency is classified as allowed, disclosed, or disqualifying; producer decision code is absent from verifier predicate kernels; and producer, adapter, and checker build/provenance hashes are recorded.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript specifies a frozen fixture set with independently authored expected outcomes and oracle provenance; a trust graph enumerating producers, adapters, checker kernels, libraries, theorem encodings, fixture-oracle authorship, and accountable implementers; an allowed, disclosed, or disqualifying classification for every shared dependency; an explicit absence of producer decision code from verifier predicate kernels; and build/provenance hashes for producer, adapter, and checker components.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies genuine trust-boundary evidence, such as a fixture provenance rule, dependency graph, code-reuse prohibition, dependency classification, or component hashes, but at least one element required by the inherited criterion remains unspecified or unauditable.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if the manuscript broadens the independence claim while leaving more producer, adapter, checker, library, theorem-encoding, oracle, or implementer dependencies undisclosed; permits producer decision code inside verifier predicate kernels; or removes fixture-oracle provenance or component-hash requirements.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: The schema surface defines canonical bytes, closed enums, a proof-type registry, state transitions, the digest domain, validator predicates, and fixture bytes that exercise both valid and invalid records.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript presents a versioned schema surface that defines canonical serialized bytes, closed enumerations, a proof-type registry, exact state transitions, the digest domain, validator predicates, and concrete fixture bytes covering both valid and invalid records.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript makes the schema genuinely more testable by defining some required elements, but one or more of canonical bytes, closed enums, proof-type registry, state transitions, digest domain, validator predicates, or valid-and-invalid fixture bytes remains missing or underspecified.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if the schema becomes less closed or less deterministic, such as by introducing open or ambiguous values, weakening canonical-byte or digest-domain rules, removing validator predicates, or reducing valid/invalid fixture coverage.

material_extension.detail: The fully-addressed test requires the schema surface to be versioned, a distinct governance requirement absent from the exact criterion. The partial test then omits versioning from its exhaustive list, confirming that the extra full-pass requirement is neither inherited nor consistently operationalized.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: Each producer contract states its exact input representation, enumeration domain and order, cutoff procedure, termination measure, coverage digest, unresolved ledger, and an independently replayable population-bound check.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: For each surface-specific producer, the manuscript states the exact input representation, theorem-bounded enumeration domain and deterministic order, cutoff procedure and exact comparison method, termination measure, coverage digest, unresolved ledger, and an independently replayable check of the population bound.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: At least one producer contract gains a genuine bounded or executable completeness component, but one or both producers still lack at least one required element: exact input, enumeration domain or order, cutoff procedure, termination measure, coverage digest, unresolved ledger, or independently replayable population-bound check.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if a producer's candidate universe, ordering, cutoff, stopping rule, coverage record, unresolved accounting, or population-bound check becomes less bounded or less replayable, or if completeness is asserted with fewer executable constraints.

material_extension.detail: The fully-addressed test requires the enumeration domain specifically to be theorem-bounded and separately requires an exact comparison method. The inherited criterion requires an enumeration domain/order and cutoff procedure but does not require that particular bounding authority or an additional comparison-method field. These stricter details are present in suggested_action, which is not a Criterion Inheritance level.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: Each source-use row has an interface, date, query, returned identifiers or an unavailable-total receipt, a screening disposition, and an exact passage/hypothesis locator; totals reconcile to 20 sources and 48 uses.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: Every source-use row records the search interface, date, query, returned identifiers or an explicit unavailable-total receipt, row-level screening disposition, and exact passage or hypothesis locator, and the resulting accounting reconciles exactly to 20 sources and 48 uses.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies genuine row-level retrieval, screening, or passage evidence for part of the workflow, but one or more source-use rows lacks a required field or the aggregate accounting does not yet reconcile to exactly 20 sources and 48 uses.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if retrieval receipts, screening dispositions, exact passage/hypothesis locators, or source-use accounting are removed or made less specific, or if the reported totals become less reconcilable to 20 sources and 48 uses.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: The control-object surface states its presentation, generator data, specialization, cutoff-predicate inputs, and canonical digest, and the control-producer contract binds to those exact values.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript gives the frozen control object's exact presentation, proof-bearing generator data, parameter specialization, exact cutoff-predicate inputs, and canonical digest, and the control-producer contract explicitly binds its inputs to those same values.

material_extension.detail: The operationalization upgrades generator data to proof-bearing generator data. The inherited criterion requires the generator data and exact producer binding but does not require a proof-bearing representation; that stricter property appears only in suggested_action and is therefore a new acceptance requirement.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: The schema fixes self-reciprocal set cardinality, deduplication, canonical ordering, inverse self-link behavior, and deterministic owner-ID derivation without double-counting a singleton inverse pair.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript's schema gives a closed self-reciprocal-owner rule that fixes set cardinality, deduplication, canonical member ordering, inverse-link self-reference, and deterministic owner-ID derivation, and demonstrates that a singleton inverse pair cannot be counted twice.

material_extension.detail: Calling the fixed rule closed and requiring the schema to demonstrate no double-counting concretizes the criterion's existing fixed-behavior and no-double-counting clauses; it does not mandate a separate example, fixture, or additional semantic property.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: A non-scientific BP/CP valid case and invalid case each show the private payload, common semantic mapping, adapter predicate, validator state transition, and fail-closed result without asserting a census outcome.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript includes non-scientific valid and invalid micro-fixtures for both BP and CP that each trace the producer-private payload through the common semantic mapping and adapter predicate to the validator state transition and precise fail-closed result, without asserting any census outcome.

material_extension.detail: The wording makes explicit the conjunctive BP-and-CP scope already carried by 'BP/CP' and restates cases as micro-fixtures; it does not add a new evidence field or scientific-result requirement.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: The policy requires exact schema-and-registry digest equality by default, and every migration has an independent version and digest with the transformed output fully revalidated.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript states exact schema-and-registry digest equality as the default compatibility rule and requires every migration to carry its own version, digest, and transformation contract, with the entire transformed output subjected to full revalidation.

material_extension.detail: The operationalization adds a transformation contract as a condition of FULLY_ADDRESSED. The exact criterion requires a migration version, digest, and full revalidation but does not require a transformation contract. Its appearance in suggested_action does not make it an inherited acceptance requirement.

item_comparisons.roadmap_exact_criterion: Every target-empty or control-nonempty statement is labeled as an unverified inherited assumption for architecture unless an exact separately authorized source/proof record is cited, and no arithmetic or Route conclusion follows from it.

phase1_operationalization.fully_addressed: Every statement that uses target-empty or control-nonempty support is explicitly typed as an unverified inherited assumption used only for architecture unless it cites an exact, separately authorized source or proof record, and none of those statements is used to derive arithmetic or Route conclusions.
phase1_operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript labels some target-empty or control-nonempty statements as unverified architectural assumptions or removes some downstream inferences, but at least one such statement remains untyped, lacks an exact separately authorized source/proof record, or still supports an arithmetic or Route conclusion.
phase1_operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if an unverified target-empty or control-nonempty assumption is presented more strongly as established evidence, an uncertainty qualification is removed, or a new or stronger arithmetic or Route conclusion is drawn from that assumption.

findings.summary: Priority claims and comparison-exclusive documentary support were added to the acceptance scope.
The exact references.bib carrier was relaxed to an undefined references surface.
Four suggested-action components were promoted into the fully-addressed test.
The all-phase-history provenance condition was narrowed to numbered-phase history.
A versioned-schema condition was added to FULLY_ADDRESSED.
Theorem-bounded enumeration and a separate exact comparison-method condition were added.
Generator data was strengthened to proof-bearing generator data.
A transformation-contract requirement was added to FULLY_ADDRESSED.

pipeline_gate_implication.reason: At least one committed Phase-1 operationalization materially changes the inherited acceptance yardstick, and none of the changes is separated into new_standards. Structural Schema validity and verbatim inherited_criterion copying do not cure semantic criterion drift.
pipeline_gate_implication.later_verdict_relevance: none; the violation occurs at the pre-evidence criterion gate
pipeline_gate_implication.protocol_first_failure_handling: One manuscript-blind Phase-1 retry is permitted with a lint-gap hint.
pipeline_gate_implication.protocol_terminal_handling: If this is the second failed Phase-1 attempt, or no clean replacement is committed before Phase 2A, surface [RE-REVIEW-ABORT: phase1_lint_failed] and emit no decision.
